meta.name: cross-reference
meta.description: Cross-reference ENCODE data with PubMed, bioRxiv, ClinicalTrials.gov, Open Targets, GTEx, ClinVar, GWAS Catalog, gnomAD, Ensembl, and other scientific databases. Use when the user wants to find publications, preprints, or clinical trials related to ENCODE experiments, chain ENCODE data with other scientific MCP servers, or build translational pipelines from genomic data to clinical application.

copy.tagline: 关联ENCODE数据与多个科学数据库，发现相关文献和临床试验。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在ENCODE实验数据与PubMed、ClinVar等数据库之间建立联系。
